title: Verify: Scheduler open, close and boundary behavior with a fake clock unit tests
summary: Unit tests for due open, expired close and ignoring future and COMPLETED rounds
description: Tests in scheduler_test.go use fakeClock, fakeController and fakeLister only; no real time, I/O or network.
acceptance_criteria: TestTick_OpensDueRound asserts calls equal one open for w1/r1
TestTick_ClosesExpiredRound asserts calls equal one close for w1/r1
TestTick_IgnoresFutureAndOtherStatuses asserts no calls at 12:00 and open plus close at 13:00

steps.action: Keep or add the test: round r1 SCHEDULED StartsAt 11:00 EndsAt 13:00, clock 12:00; assert Tick returns nil and ctrl.calls equals [{open w1 r1}] via reflect.DeepEqual
Keep or add the test: round r1 OPEN EndsAt 11:59, clock 12:00; assert nil error and ctrl.calls equals [{close w1 r1}]

Keep or add the test: future SCHEDULED (13:00), future OPEN (ends 13:00) and COMPLETED rounds; assert zero calls at 12:00, set clock.now to 13:00, assert calls equal open future-scheduled then close future-open
